Your brain is split into two hemispheres that focus on different tasks. Your left hemisphere is more analytical and detail-oriented, your right hemisphere is more intuitive and impulsive.

When you play Freaky Focus both hemispheres have to communicate (through the famous corpus callosum) to decide whether there is a conflict. This trains you to use both hemispheres effectively when you solve problems or make decisions!
